cadence_notes: Post Monday-Friday at 8:00 AM ET (when attorneys check LinkedIn before court/meetings). Never post weekends — law firm owners aren't on LinkedIn Saturday/Sunday. Batch-create content on Fridays for the following week. Repurpose top-performing posts into Twitter threads (same day, 2pm), YouTube shorts (within 48 hours), and email newsletter (Sunday night). Each series should run for minimum 8 weeks before evaluating performance. Track engagement rate by series — double down on what works, kill what doesn't after 12 weeks.
engagement_strategy: Daily 30-45 min engagement window (9:00-9:45 AM ET, right after posting): (1) Respond to every comment on your post within first hour — this signals LinkedIn's algorithm to push it further. (2) Find 5 posts from law firm owners using hashtags #lawfirmmarketing #legalmarketing #lawfirmowner and leave substantive comments (2-3 sentences, add insight, don't pitch). (3) Check notifications for mentions/tags and respond immediately. (4) Friday bonus: DM 3-5 people who engaged heavily with that week's content — start real conversations, don't sell. The goal is to be SEEN daily in the right feeds, not to spam. Quality over quantity. One great comment beats 10 generic ones.
